hooks.command: if command -v perl >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec perl "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/process/check-environment.pl" --hook; fi; printf '{"systemMessage":"Environment check: 1 condition failed\\n  1 a perl is on PATH; see docs/development-environment.md § Troubleshooting a failed condition, condition 1","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"Environment check (SessionStart hook in .claude/settings.json): no perl on PATH, so process/check-environment.pl did not run.\\nPATH:   %s\\n\\n 1  FAIL  a perl is on PATH\\n            see: docs/development-environment.md § Troubleshooting a failed condition, condition 1\\n"}}\n' "$PATH"
